# mizchi-skill

> Use at the start of a software task to find and load the matching skill from mizchi/skills — repository setup, CI and GitHub Actions, releases and npm publishing, OSS docs and changelogs, dependency updates, testing, Playwright and flaky tests, Cloudflare, AWS or Kubernetes deploys, SQL, Nix, task runners (pkfire, just), MoonBit, Gleam or TypeScript practice, frontend review, OpenTelemetry, technical writing, project retrospectives and KPIs. Skip it when an installed skill already matches or the request is a one-line answer.

## Install

### APM (recommended)

```bash
apm install mizchi/skills/mizchi-skill
```

Or declare it in `apm.yml` for a reproducible setup:

```yaml
dependencies:
  apm:
    - mizchi/skills/mizchi-skill
```

then run `apm install`.

### Any agentskills.io-compatible agent

This is an [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) skill — a portable
`SKILL.md` folder that works with Claude Code, Codex, opencode, Gemini CLI,
Cursor, and other [compatible agents](https://agentskills.io/clients).

With the [`skills`](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills) CLI (installs into
every detected agent's skills directory):

```bash
npx skills add mizchi/skills --skill mizchi-skill
```

Or copy the folder in directly:

```bash
npx degit mizchi/skills/mizchi-skill ~/.claude/skills/mizchi-skill
```

See [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) for what this skill does and when to use it.
